_scale: Points on the same scale as the weapon score: 10 points = 1 extra average damage on every hit (the value of 1 Strength). Edit these numbers to match how strong you think each perk is; the checker uses them as-is.
_pairs: A perk and its twin (burn + burn_on_hit, poison + poison_on_hit, stealth + stealth_strike) are counted once, using the higher value.

double_strike.why: Two attack rolls per action: roughly doubles the weapon's own damage (worth about one extra weapon hit).

earth_shatter.why: +1d8 on every hit (4.5 dmg) and -2 Physical Defence on the target.

lightning_arrows.why: +1d6 on every hit (3.5 dmg) plus 40% chance to Incapacitate for a turn.

dragon_fire.why: +1d6 fire on every hit plus 75% chance to Burn.

elemental_mastery_passive.why: +1d4 elemental damage on all attacks and immunity to one element.

thunder_strike.why: +1d6 on every hit plus 40% chance to Incapacitate for a turn.

void_impact.why: +1d6 on every hit and a 10ft push.

wind_slash.why: Extra 1d6 wind blade at 20ft with a push.

earthquake.why: 10ft burst for 2d6 plus Knockdown: area damage on top of the hit.

holy_strike.why: +1d6 radiant on every hit, +2 Accuracy against undead and demons.

star_arrows.why: +1d6 radiant on every ranged hit, +2 Accuracy in darkness.

cosmic_power.why: +4 Magic Power and +2 Magical Defence for 6 turns (counted at about half uptime).

lifesteal.why: Heals half the damage dealt, about 3 HP a hit: strong staying power.

sweeping_strikes.why: One attack can hit a second adjacent target at -1 Accuracy.

reality_cut.why: Once per scene: ignore all defence and add 2d6.

burn_on_hit.why: 40% chance to Burn: about 4 damage over time and -2 Strength on the target.

poison_on_hit.why: 40% chance to Poison: 1+2+3 damage over 3 turns.

phase_strike.why: Ignores 3 Physical and 3 Magical Defence: like +3 Accuracy on every attack.

rage_mode.why: +2 Strength, +2 Speed, -1 Physical Defence for 8 turns.

drain_mana.why: Target loses 1d4+1 Stamina and you regain half.

mana_efficiency.why: Skills cost 1 less Stamina for 10 turns.

time_strike.why: Once per scene: one extra weapon attack.

execution.why: +1d6 against targets below half HP (about half of each fight).

creation_magic.why: +3 Magic Power for 8 turns plus story effects.

elemental_mastery.why: +2 Magic Power and +1 Accuracy with elemental skills for 10 turns.

armor_pierce.why: Target's Physical Defence -2 for the attack: like +2 Accuracy.

piercing.why: Ignore 2 cover or Physical Defence: like +2 Accuracy.

cleave.why: Half damage to a neighbour, but only when the attack drops or crits.

shock_on_hit.why: 40% chance to Incapacitate for a turn, only on a failed save.

stealth_strike.why: First attack from hiding gets +2 Accuracy and +1d6.

dimension_pierce.why: Once per scene: ignore barriers and 6 defence.

anti_cavalry.why: +2 Accuracy and +1d6, but only against mounted or charging foes.

dragon_slayer.why: +2 Accuracy and +1d6, but only against dragons.

undead_bane.why: +2 Accuracy and +1d6, but only against undead.

nature_blessing.why: +2 Accuracy, +1 Magic Power and 1 HP a turn, only outdoors.

critical_strike.why: Crits on 19-20 instead of 20, with an extra damage die.

parry_bonus.why: +2 Physical Defence, only while parrying or blocking.

piercing_light.why: +1d4 against shadow or undead, and no darkness penalty.
